translation_direction: ja → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Japanese electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: The old retainer speaks as tôi with deferential spoken particles (ạ, thì phải, chẳng phải… đó sao) and his evasions about the lord are left unresolved.
decisions.rationale: The story’s horror depends on what the unreliable narrator will not say.

decisions.decision: The narrator calls Yoshihide lão; before the lord Yoshihide calls himself tiểu nhân.
decisions.rationale: Contempt in narration, servility in address.

decisions.decision: Sino-Vietnamese Buddhist vocabulary: Viêm nhiệt địa ngục, Thập Vương, pháp lạc, khai nhãn, tăng thượng mạn.
decisions.rationale: Matches the period and religious register of the source.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: Title changed from Bức bình phong địa ngục to Địa ngục biến, matching the source title and the body term.
苦々しい御調子 no longer implies grief: giọng gay gắt.
東三條 is a place name (Higashi Sanjō), not a direction.
ついぞ又となかつた now means ‘never met anything like it’, not ‘never met it again’.

Calques 結燈臺, 五六間 and 狐が憑く replaced (cây đèn đế, mươi bước, hồ ly nhập); 御靈 as oan hồn; 傀儡 glossed in text; 姉君 as chị gái; 141 出かし居つた regains its grudging edge; phán reserved for the lord; 117 and 24 smoothed.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: Địa ngục biến (tấm bình phong Địa ngục biến)
glossary.rationale: The established Sino-Vietnamese title, used both for the work and for the screen in the body.

glossary.source_term: 堀川の大殿樣 / 若殿樣 / 御姫樣 / 御臺樣
glossary.draft_rendering: Đức Đại điện / Đức Tiểu điện / Công nương / Đức phu nhân
glossary.rationale: Fixed honorifics for the household; Đức Đại điện is never shortened in the narrator’s mouth.

glossary.draft_rendering: con khỉ Yoshihide; 猿秀 Hide Khỉ
glossary.rationale: Keeps the young lord’s joke of naming the monkey after the painter.
Conventional rendering of the palm-thatched court carriage, fixed through the climax.

witness_decision: Selected the Aozora Bunko transcription (card 61, file 61_15130) made from the facsimile reprint of 傀儡師 (新潮社, 1919), the story’s first book publication, in old kanji and kana. First serialised in 大阪毎日新聞 / 東京日日新聞, May 1918; not collated. One Aozora note records 眴 corrected from 眗 in the base text; the corrected reading is used.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Nested quotation uses single quotes inside double quotes; the 姉君/妹君 inconsistency of the source is reproduced, not harmonised.

title_review.rationale: Địa ngục biến is the established Sino-Vietnamese title and the term the body uses for the screen; 變 names a picture of the transformations of hell, which a descriptive title would lose.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Opening portrait of the lord with the narrator’s qualifications intact.
Climax in sections 17–19 complete and precise.
